description: Tester bug reports (feedback of kind bug from the install page, the in-app link or TestFlight) on the builds of one builder app, newest first: id, message, reporter, device, model, osVersion, screen, appScreen, status open or resolved, blocker, the build (version label, platform), screenshots (files), link = the full report in the Feedback inbox, and fix = the Fix with AI state: fixing (the AI edit runs), in_progress (the edit passed and made versionNumber; it waits for a build), failed (the edit did not pass, credits given back), fixed (a build of that version or later was added: fixedIn; the report got "Fixed in version X" and was resolved; replied = the tester was emailed, Team plan with an address). project = null until the app has a build. status: open (default), resolved or all; before = next page. With report (an id from the list): also prompt = the editable Fix with AI request for it (text and device facts, no images). Read only. Every plan with an account.

before.description: Report id from next (the next page)

report.description: Bug report id (optional): adds its Fix with AI prompt

name: builder_bugs
title: Bug reports of a builder app
